Project01.paragraph: Built an AI-powered form responder using Microsoft Forms, Azure Logic Apps, Outlook, and Azure OpenAI. The workflow captures form submissions, uses Azure OpenAI to generate intelligent responses, and sends automated replies through Outlook. The deployed cloud resources were disabled/deleted after testing to control Azure costs, while architecture documentation and screenshots are preserved for demonstration.
features1: Microsoft Forms trigger captures new form submissions automatically
Azure Logic Apps retrieves the submitted response details
Azure OpenAI generates a customized AI response
Microsoft Outlook sends the generated response by email
End-to-end workflow reduces manual follow-up and saves time

Project02.paragraph: The Email Reminder Agent takes an email, reminder message and the date/time you want to send your reminder. Then verifies the user's email via a 6 digit email verification process. After this, the agent schedules your reminder to be sent to your email at the requested date/time.
features1: Schedule reminders to yourself in the future
Email verification done by agent
Azure Container Apps for hosting frontend userface and AI Agent logic
Azure AI Foundry for hosting deployed LLM
Azure Cosmos DB for storing verification data and scheduled reminders
Azure Functions for forwarding scheduled reminder via Timer trigger to Azure Logic App
Azure Logic Apps to send verification emails and scheduled reminder emails sent from Azure Function
Azure Container Apps for hosting container images for Azure Container Apps

Project03.paragraph: Dog Walkers United is a Power Platform business application built with Power Apps, SharePoint, and Power Automate. The app allows staff to manage dog profiles, track walking trips, view future bookings, and trigger automated invoice workflows. The solution integrates Power Apps with SharePoint lists as the backend and uses Power Automate to create workflow actions such as invoice tasks, reminders, and third-party system updates through connectors like Trello.
Project03.note: Access note: This app is best presented as an internal staff Power Apps solution. Unlike Power Pages, which can be designed for external website users, external users cannot directly access this Power Apps app unless they are added to the organization and given the correct permissions and licensing.
features1: Dog Profile Management - Allows users to view and manage dog profiles, including dog names, photos, owner details, breed, gender, and related information
Trip Tracking - Displays completed dog walking trips with trip date, dog name, walker, duration, rating, and trip photos
Trip Details View - Provides a detailed view of each selected trip, showing the dog, walker, walk duration, rating, and related images
Future Booking Management - Helps track upcoming dog walking bookings, including scheduled dates, assigned walkers, and dogs to be walked
Search and Sorting Functionality - Allows users to filter and sort trip records by date, name, or other available fields for easier navigation
Power Apps User Interface - Built with Microsoft Power Apps to provide a clean, interactive, low-code business application experience
SharePoint Data Integration - Uses SharePoint lists as the backend data source for storing dogs, trips, bookings, and related business records
Power Automate Workflow Integration - Connects Power Apps to Power Automate to trigger automated processes directly from the app
Invoice Automation - Allows users to trigger invoice-related workflows from a selected trip, reducing manual administrative work
Trello Integration - Creates Trello invoice task cards from Power Automate, helping the business track invoice processing activities
Role-Based Business Process Flow - Supports a practical business workflow where walkers, dog profiles, trips, bookings, and invoice tasks are connected in one system

Project04.paragraph: ElectroHub Tech Guide is a conversational AI assistant designed for an electronics retailer. The agent helps customers discover suitable products, retrieve technical information, and check order details through a combination of structured conversation topics, Power Automate agent flows, interactive cards, and knowledge-grounded generative AI.
features1: Product inquiry and recommendation conversations
Category and budget collection
JSON product-catalog filtering
Power Automate agent-flow integration
Interactive Adaptive Cards
Power Fx expressions and variable management
Custom and system topic configuration
Generative orchestration
Knowledge-grounded answers with citations
Controlled fallback and escalation
Authentication and privacy protection
Content moderation and response instructions
